title: Schedules plotted in Figure 6 (exact-error study)
note: Every b vector here was checked against richardson.py: given the q grid, the repo reproduces the coefficients exactly (rtol 1e-6). The five wc grids are the LKW closed form at m = 2, 3, 4, 5, 7. The eight opt grids are not produced by the committed brute-force search at either q_max=10 or q_max=15, so the search run that selected them is not in this repository; they are recorded here so Figure 6 remains reproducible while that provenance is resolved.
